messages:
Nora: Heads-up: Zenith Micro provided a small EAP drop (silicon + q8 artifact). They requested a 10-day preview, NDA signed. Need bench owners and a short publicity checklist.

Sam: I can run microbench harness and collect p50/p95, tokens/sec, and GPU mem. Will reuse the standard template but need the artifact location and SSH creds.

Vik: I9ll handle provisioning and route setup. Suggested pool name: zenith-eap-02. Will provision 2 nodes first. Ops-bot, can you reserve?

ops-bot: Reserved zenith-eap-02: 2x A40. Staging bucket: s3://redwood-zenith-eap/artifacts. Access granted to partnerships+eng-runtime.

Sam: Thanks. Also note: Zenith gives int8 + fp16. I9ll run both and add a conversion sanity check.

Claire: Legal check: publicity clause requires partner approval 72h before any external mention. Also confirm no raw prompts are in logs. I9ll review telemetry redaction step.

Nora: Good. For the run plan: Tue smoke (15m), Wed full microbench (90m), Thu quality suite (30m). Sam, include KV warm-up and token-breakdown.

Sam: Will do. Snippet for redaction I'll use: cat runs.json | jq '[.[] | {uid:.uid,metrics:.metrics,model:.model}]' > redacted.json

Vik: Routing plan: set 10% traffic to zenith-eap-02 and 90% to hosted for tail compare. Will post route config once done.

Nora: Owners: Sam (bench + redaction), Vik (infra + routing), Claire (legal). Sync tomorrow 09:30 PT in #partnerships to finalize. Nora out.
